claim: CloudWatch is integrated with CloudTrail: CloudTrail captures API calls made by or on behalf of your account, including calls from the CloudWatch console and code calls to CloudWatch API operations, and from this information you can determine the request that was made, the IP address it came from and when it was made.

evidence.quote: CloudTrail captures API calls made by or on behalf of your AWS account. The captured calls include calls from the CloudWatch console and code calls to CloudWatch API operations.
Using the information collected by CloudTrail, you can determine the request that was made to CloudWatch, the IP address from which the request was made, when it was made, and additional details.
